screen: SEASON STATS — KICKING, scope NATIONAL, sorted by FGM descending
method: Twenty-two columns span three screens. IMG_5217 carries GP through XP%, IMG_5218 the distance buckets plus KO and TB, IMG_5219 from FGA49 rightwards to SNAPS. All three keep the NAME column, so they were merged by player name and all 138 names matched in order. The overlapping columns between screens two and three agree row for row.
validation: Five independent identities hold on all 138 rows: the four distance buckets sum to FGM and to FGA; FG% equals floor(100*FGM/FGA); XP% equals floor(100*XPM/XPA); and TB% equals TB/KO. The FGA bucket sum caught a misread FGA49 of 3 for K.Meester, corrected to 4 from the frame at full resolution.
teams: No team column. Three kickers were identified in the earlier pass and keep their labels.
list_length: 138 kickers — exactly one per FBS team, the same count as the punting list.
